title: The Laboratory
content: *I posted this in r/anonsphropheticdream recently. I only just discovered this sun and wanted to see if anyone has visited the same place. Recently I experienced the most vivid dream I’ve had for sometime. To prefix I have had dreams of mundane instances which turned out to manifest in my waking life. But never have I seen what I experience in this dream. The dream: it’s sunset, bathed in warm light , Im in a clearing in the middle of forest, in the center of the clearing is a massive green house. It looks like a building that would house an Olympic size pool, all the walls to the building are glass so you can see right in. Im with my SO and we approach the building and look inward. To my horror, it’s a tiled open space with a long row of people laying on top of one long white clothe. Every person is bloated , discoloured and covered in what appear to be wires and tubes entering and exiting their bodies. The bodies were discoloured to a dark maroon and brown, similar to dried blood. A women in a lab coat notices us looking by inward and motions to someone at us. They grab my SO from behind and take her inside, while I’m panicking, trying to stop them. The glass doors close and I’m stuck outside. I start banging on the glass as hard as I can in a panic. The women motions to me to stop , which I do not. Two people grab me from behind and drag me inside and slam me into a table. The women then says to me something along the lines of “ hold still, we are going to give you a gift” The next thing I know, they have opens my shirt from behind and proceed to lay what I can only describe as a giant beige and pink slug on my back. She says “stay still while it absorbs into you”. I do not and begin to shriek . I feel EVERYTHING. It’s warm, wet, tingly and when I’m released from their grip, I stand up and reach around to my neck and I can feel this thing attached to my back, I feels the edges of it and it’s wet and slippery. It doesn’t hurt but it scared the living f*ck out of me to the point where I rip myself awake. This is now the next day as I post this, and I can still remember everything very clearly which is unusual for me. Normally I forget my dreams with in moments of waking up. What the actual f*ck Anyone else seen the laboratory?
